Map each large service-family row to owner, purpose, environment, rollback owner, retention or customer-impact gate, post-change measurement window and blocked claim boundary. AICS should be positioned as proof-before-change support, not as a replacement for AWS-native evidence, qualified advisers, MSPs, FinOps platforms or measured billing data.
